capabilities: Capture cards via a sidebar or floating input with Ctrl+Enter into a monthly Markdown file
Save selected text from any note as a card without a source link
Filter and search cards across all months by tag, date, time, phrase or citation status
Review a random batch of five long-unseen cards and insert them into the current note
Edit, delete and restore cards, with undo, recent-deletions and multi-select batch actions
extras: The README is written mainly in Chinese with a shorter English section at the end covering the same features; it also documents limits (no cloud sync of its own, plain text inside cards) and states the plugin runs fully offline with no telemetry.
problem: Recording a fleeting thought in Obsidian normally means creating a file with a title and folder first, which adds friction to quick capture.
summary: Quick-capture card tool that saves timestamped cards as plain Markdown list items in a monthly vault file, with search, filters, review and citing.
